title: EDA Workbench
description: Follow a chip from contract to silicon: topology, Ball gates, runs and waveform evidence in one place.

overview.noActiveJobs: No jobs running. Start a simulation or a gate run.
overview.agentHint: The agent can read the same run and stage data and propose the next gate to fix.
overview.agentPrompt: chip={{chip}}: which balls are blocked, and what should I run next?

chips.agentHint: Ask the agent to compare this topology against the mesh_shm contract.
chips.agentPrompt: chip={{chip}} ({{cores}} cores, {{tiles}} tiles): review the topology and the mesh_shm connection contract.

balls.grayHint: Stage blocked — fix the upstream failure to continue.
balls.redHint: Gate failed — ask the agent for a patch, then rerun this stage.
balls.agentPrompt: Look at ball={{ball}} stage={{stage}}: what is the root cause and the next step?
balls.explainPrompt: Explain ball={{ball}} stage={{stage}} ({{metric}}) and tell me what to fix.

waveforms.agentPrompt: Look at waveform {{file}} around t={{cursor}} and explain whether there is a conflict.

advanced.filePrompt: Look at {{path}} and explain the logic and potential issues.
advanced.openHint: Open a file from the explorer.
